intro.title: Vote for the {{brand}} logo
intro.lead: From the answers to the first survey we made 4 proposals: all of them have the kanji 芯 in brush strokes, with soft shapes. Now we pick one, and its colors, with your vote.
intro.how: 6 short steps, about 2 minutes. Only the proposal and its colors are required. If you close the page, you'll pick up where you left off.
intro.small: On the taskbar and in the system tray the logo is 16 pixels: there it uses a simple version with the flame (the small box under each proposal, at real size).
intro.edit: You already voted. You can change your answers: they replace the previous ones.

pick.title: Which one would you pick?
pick.lead: The one that best represents {{brand}}. If you're torn between two, the other goes in the next step.

second.title: And your second choice?
second.lead: If the one you picked didn't exist. You can skip this step.

palette.title: Which colors?
palette.lead: This is how your pick looks in each palette.

ratings.title: Want to rate each proposal?
ratings.lead: Optional: a score from 1 (don't like it) to 5 (love it) for each one.
ratings.open: Yes, I want to rate them
ratings.label: Score for "{{name}}"

comment.title: Anything you'd change?
comment.lead: In your pick or any other: shapes, colors, ideas. You can leave it empty.
comment.label: Comment

review.title: Review and send
review.lead: If something isn't how you wanted, tap "Change".
review.name: Your name
review.nameHint: However you want us to know you: your name or your Discord nickname.
review.privacy: We store your name and your answers, nothing else: no email, no IP. Only the {{brand}} team sees them.

done.title: Thanks, {{name}}!
done.text: Your vote is in. With the results we'll finish the logo: the icon at every size, the colors and a short usage guide.
done.interfaz: Have you answered the survey about the app's interface?

errors.invalid_name: Write a name of 2 to 60 characters.
errors.invalid_answers: Some answer isn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many submissions from your connection. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find your previous answer. Send it as a new one.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: It couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.
